finding: The stage's cost varies by about +-25% between identical runs (one crop: 413 to 673 EECU-seconds). Per crop, the region costs 407 to 616, inside that range: the stage scales about linearly with the crop count, and the earlier 6 x was mostly that variance. One 448-pixel shard cost 8% less than one-crop shards but took 19.4 minutes against 11.8, so one-crop shards stay the default.
